summary: FB-02 increment tested (GPS positions + read-only logistics menu for sales/sales_admin). Backend: 10/10 pytest passed (POST /positions with lat/lng persists floats & last_position, without lat/lng -> 200 with nulls, non-numeric lat -> 422, short location -> 422, sales read GET list/detail/summary 200 while POST position -> 403). Frontend: sales & salesadmin see nav-logistics, logistics-readonly banner, no create button, no logistics-actions, no position form, Leaflet map renders (8 tiles, 4 markers, 1 polyline) with logistics-pos-gps-* coordinate rows. Driver 'Ambil GPS' works with mocked geolocation (button shows '-6.2, 106.8'), position submitted -> new row with coords, map still single instance, status kept in_transit. Regression: admin & warehouse keep create button + actions + GPS button. ONE REAL BUG FOUND: positions with null lat/lng are plotted at 0,0 so logistics-map-empty never shows and the map zooms out to the Atlantic/Africa.

ui_bugs.issue: Filter uses Number.isFinite(Number(p.lat)) — Number(null)===0, so positions WITHOUT GPS are treated as coordinate (0,0). Consequences: (a) KSC/LG-00005 (prepared, 1 position without lat/lng) shows a map with a marker in the ocean instead of data-testid=logistics-map-empty (spec item 4 FAILS); (b) after a driver records any position without pressing 'Ambil GPS', fitBounds includes (0,0) and the LG-00007 map zooms out to Africa/Indian Ocean, making the real route unreadable. Fix: pts filter should be `p.lat != null && p.lng != null && Number.isFinite(Number(p.lat)) && Number.isFinite(Number(p.lng))`.

rca_of_the_issue: PositionMap.jsx line 12: positions.filter((p) => Number.isFinite(Number(p.lat)) && Number.isFinite(Number(p.lng))). Number(null) coerces to 0 which is finite, so GPS-less positions become (0,0) points; they are then plotted and included in map.fitBounds, and pts.length is never 0 so the logistics-map-empty branch is unreachable whenever any position exists.
